newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil industrial employment falls 0.4 pct-IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil industrial employment falls 0.4 pct-IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian April industrial employment fell 0.4 percent from March and 5.4 percent compared with April 1996, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
Industrial employment fell 5.7 percent in the first four months of 1997, the IBGE said in a statement.
The IBGE said April employment levels declined most in Sao Paulo state and in the Northeast both at 0.9 percent, while in the South industrial employment increased 0.3 percent.
The largest employment losses were in the beverages and electrical and communications goods sectors, the IBGE said.
Total salaries paid decreased 0.6 percent from March and 5.4 percent in comparison with April 1996, the IBGE said.
The total number of hours paid increased 3.1 percent between February and March, but decreased 5.6 percent in comparison with March 1996, the IBGE said.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
